instructions: Preserve WIPO source applicant and patent fields exactly. Extract applicant and agent blocks independently; never assume email or phone belongs to an agent.

Use the printed Name field in each labeled contact block. Record signing individuals and explicitly named signing organisations separately as signature evidence; do not substitute a signer into the contact block's owner name. Never infer an employer from an email or a surname.
Read email and phone characters exactly. Fax and registration numbers are excluded. Missing or unclear fields are not guessed.
Quote complete visible evidence per field; keep country in the printed language. A country or address problem must not invalidate a separately verified email or phone.
Return each visibly printed email as its own field, even when several emails share one printed line. Never combine addresses into one value or repair malformed text.

Retain multiple owners and shared contact details as separate blocks. After the applicant-versus-agent policy selects agent contacts, prefer the unique agent block explicitly linked to the printed signing organisation or the exact printed signer name. Keep its email, phone and country together. Ambiguous or absent signer links fall back to the existing applicant/primary-agent rules; never choose by email spelling or presumed seniority.

Preserve role priority: prefer a verified applicant email when contacts differ; if the applicant has no email, use the independently verified agent email block. When contacts are shared, applicant for same address and agent for different addresses. Ambiguous owner-dependent fields require review, but a single independently verified email may be retained.

Preserve other verified applicant/agent emails with their printed owner and role for the Additional Email report column; omit duplicates of the selected main email. Exclude patent-office and inventor-only contacts.

Keep contact-owner/agent names in their source blocks. The report Name is a separately verified person for greeting: a selected applicant individual, an associated named representative, or an explicitly owner-linked signatory. Do not infer a person from an email or choose an inventor merely because they are listed. Sir/Ma'am is a placeholder, not an identity.

Category is an assigned worksheet management label: Slf for the verified representative role, Corp for a corporate applicant contact, Ind for an individual applicant contact. A company employee signing for the company does not make the contact Ind. Unknown roles stay in review. Duplicate handling is separate and never follows repeated email alone.
Examples teach rules only; never copy example contacts into a filing.

examples.observed: Applicant Example Manufacturing: applicant@example.com. Agent Example Counsel: counsel@example.org.
examples.expected: Preserve both owners in evidence; select applicant contact under different-information rule. Agent Name remains Example Counsel, not Example Manufacturing.
examples.explanation: Contact ownership and Agent Name are distinct.

examples.observed: No agent block; applicant has email only.
examples.expected: Keep applicant email with applicant role. Agent Name display Sir/Ma'am.
examples.explanation: No agent is not the same as no contact.

examples.observed: Primary firm and additional attorney each list the same phone/email/address.
examples.expected: Keep both in evidence; select the primary complete contact block.
examples.explanation: Do not mix owners or reject identical reachable contacts merely because both are printed.

examples.observed: Agent contact Name: Example Counsel LLP. Signature Name: Example Counsel LLP. Name of signatory: Dr. Mira Example.
examples.expected: Keep Example Counsel LLP as the contact owner. After independent source verification, use Mira Example in the greeting Name column and Slf as the management category. Keep its email and phone unchanged.
examples.explanation: Greeting person, contact ownership and management category have separate purposes.
